⛔ Re-derived, not read. And on two of the three residuals the dev's repair is **better than what the dispatch asked for**; that is stated below rather than absorbed silently.

## Residual 1 — the count came out, and the reason it gave is the part worth keeping

The four drifted control counts are gone from the `objectql.ts` docblock and the walk that derives them is named instead. ⭐ **The dev then drew a line the dispatch did not**: the word **ZERO** stays while the four counts go, because ZERO is that pin's **own assertion, re-derived on every run** (the `it` at `object-kanban-allow-collapse-retired-8801.test.ts:220`), whereas the four were readings taken once. ⇒ `AGENTS.md` #9 is not "no numbers in prose" — it is "no REMEMBERED answers in prose", and this diff is the first artefact on this lane to say so in as many words.

## Residual 2 — route (b) taken, and it loses NOTHING; verified at the pin

The dispatch made route (b) conditional on SHOWING the refusal is pinned elsewhere. It is, at `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-kanban-allow-collapse-retired-8801.test.ts:137`:

```
it.each([[true], [false], ['yes']])('refuses the value %p at the key\'s OWN path, with the prescription', …)
```

…asserting the key's own path, and the message content the ruling itself requires (`KanbanColumn.collapsed`, `not a board-level authored toggle`, `Delete the key`). ⇒ dropping the restating row in `bare-kanban-node-key-retired-8802.test.ts` removes a duplicate, not a pin.

⭐ **The title repair is sharper than the card's request.** The card asked for a title that stops contradicting the suite. The dev noticed the old title made a **wider claim than the suite ever measured** — "keeps every verdict it had" — and replaced it with the narrow one the suite does measure: *retiring the bare `kanban` arm moved NO verdict on the sibling arm*. The stale row survived a week precisely because the wider claim looked like it covered it.

## ⚠️ A false zero this seat produced, and the dev had already predicted it

Probing for that `it` title with a plain apostrophe returned **0**. That is not an absence — the source spells it `key\'s`, escaped, exactly as the dev's own out-of-scope note warned. Re-drawn apostrophe-tolerantly it is found at `:137`, against a **[LIT CTRL]** of 11 `it(` in the file and an **[ABSENT CTRL]** of 0.

⇒ ⭐ **A dev's "noted, not filed" caught a reviewer's instrument before the reviewer drew it.** Recorded because the reverse is the usual direction.

## Residual 3 — the enumeration was replaced by LOCATIONS, not by a longer count

The short list now names where each occurrence is, carries its scan date, and adds the missing `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` hit — correctly characterised, too: it is a comment recording that a deleted helper once carried this spelling on the **sibling** arm, ⛔ not a live declaration. The paragraph states why counts are excluded (it publishes verbatim into the CHANGELOG at an unknown future date), which is the same reasoning residual 1 turns on.

Prose, one changeset body, one docblock, and the removal of a duplicated test row. ⛔ No published face moved in either direction; ⛔ no assertion was weakened — the dropped row's claim is asserted, more strongly, at its own pin.

## Region fence — held, and my own claim table was short TWICE

⚠️ Owned rather than explained: the claim comment enumerated this round's branches and missed **two** standing PRs that share `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`. objectui#9540 I caught and corrected mid-flight; **objectui#8941** (`claude/pr-7058-lucide-react-1.41.0`, open, touching that file at `:481`) the dev found on its required re-take and I had not. The fence holds at REGION granularity in both cases — this diff sits at `:3823`, inside `ObjectKanbanSchema` (`:3385`), and `ObjectGallerySchema` starts at `:4358` — but the reading was the dev's, not mine, and the dispatch template is what needs fixing, not the dev.

- The escaped-apostrophe citation form in the 8801 pin's titles: citation by test NAME is the sanctioned form, so recorded for whoever next edits those titles rather than worked around.

⇒ **Merging.** Draft cleared and queued once CI is green on the head.
